# Axis Bank Limited

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-29 · status **partial** · Budget spent (7 searches, 6 document fetches incl. one failed re-fetch of AR2023-24). Got full FY2024-25 CSR annexure for Axis Bank Limited and 3-year spend series for Axis Bank Foundation's flagship programme, but could not retrieve FY2023-24/FY2022-23 statutory CSR annexure figures (average net profit / prescribed CSR / total spent) for Axis Bank Limited itself - only a 3-year unspent-account carryover table was found.

Axis Bank Limited (CIN L65110GJ1993PLC020769) is the Section 135-bound corporate parent; Axis Bank Foundation (ABF, already in catalog as funder:7) is its distinct CSR foundation, running the Sustainable Livelihoods Programme (SLP). Confirmed via Axis Bank's own Board's Report: 'The Bank has been formally undertaking Corporate Social Responsibility ("CSR") activities since 2006, with the founding of Axis Bank Foundation ("ABF").' Full FY2024-25 statutory CSR annexure obtained for Axis Bank Limited (avg net profit Rs21,296.18cr, prescribed CSR Rs425.92cr, spent Rs286.92cr total). ABF's SLP spend obtained for all three requested years (FY2022-23 Rs113.53cr, FY2023-24 Rs154.01cr, FY2024-25 Rs231.96cr). Extensive partner lists, thematic programmes, footprints and metrics captured for both entities from BRSR FY2024-25, Integrated Annual Report FY2024-25, CSR Impact Report FY2024-25 and ABF Annual Report FY2024-25. Note: research_goals' fuzzy name-match surfaced funder:2 'HDFC Bank Limited' against the query 'Axis Bank Limited' - this is a mismatched trigram-similarity artifact, not the same entity; Axis Bank Limited did not previously exist as its own funder row in the catalog.

Website: https://www.axisbank.com

## What it set out to find

- identity and identifiers for Axis Bank Limited and Axis Bank Foundation, and the parent/foundation relationship
- CSR years FY2022-23, FY2023-24, FY2024-25 (section 135 obligation, spend, overheads, unspent) for both entities
- project-level and aggregate CSR spend, including aspirational-district spend
- footprints (states/districts where themes actually ran) vs stated priority geography
- implementation/NGO partners per programme and fiscal year
- programmes/themes hierarchy
- metrics (beneficiaries, outreach) with self-reported vs assessed basis
- key CSR/foundation office bearers as contacts
- source documents (BRSR, annual report, CSR annexure, foundation annual report)

## Implementing partners

- **Akshaya Patra Foundation · foundation · Education** (FY2022-23)
  > Axis Bank in partnership with the Akshaya Patra Foundation provided Mid-Day Meals ("MDM") to select schools in Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat, Karnataka, and Odisha covering about 1 Lakh children between December 2022 and March 2023.
  <sub>Axis Bank Integrated Annual Report 2024-25, Annexure 4 · https://www.axis.bank.in/docs/default-source/annual-reports/for-axis-bank/annual-report-for-the-year-2024-2025.pdf · confidence high</sub>
- **CSC Academy · other · Financial Inclusion & Literacy** (FY2022-23)
  > The Financial Literacy Program, supported by Axis Bank and implemented by CSC Academy, aimed to enhance financial understanding among rural populations in India using 20 mobile vans operated by Village Level Entrepreneurs (VLEs).
  <sub>Axis Bank Integrated Annual Report 2024-25, Annexure 4 · https://www.axis.bank.in/docs/default-source/annual-reports/for-axis-bank/annual-report-for-the-year-2024-2025.pdf · confidence high</sub>
- **Sri Sathya Sai Health & Education Trust · ngo · Health and Nutrition** (FY2022-23)
  > Axis Bank in partnership with Sri Sathya Sai Health & Education Trust supported 300 heart surgeries for the children suffered by congenital heart disease at Sri Sathya Sai Sanjeevani Hospital during fiscal 2023.
  <sub>Axis Bank Integrated Annual Report 2024-25, Annexure 4 · https://www.axis.bank.in/docs/default-source/annual-reports/for-axis-bank/annual-report-for-the-year-2024-2025.pdf · confidence high</sub>
